the following: The development of a framework for risk analysis in health care information systems; The identification of information security risks in a hospital information system; The development of a model for information security risk management in a hospital information environment.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current state of information technology in health care in Iran is not satisfactory.

the current state of information security risk management (ISRM) in computerized health information (CHI) systems in Iranian hospitals is not at a level of maturity that would satisfy most of the stakeholders.

information security risk management for health information systems in Iran has not been conducted in a systematic way, and the results of this study show a lack of awareness and knowledge among Iranian hospitals in information security risk management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our results suggest that the use of a structured risk management process, based on a risk analysis model, can be used to support decision making in the implementation of information security controls.

the risk management process is an important tool for information security in hospitals.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the current approach of using the NIST CSF to assess information security risk is not sufficient to provide an adequate understanding of the risks associated with the use of computerized health information.
